titulo: Certainty in the midst of fear
resumen: Before the spies lay down, Rahab went up to the roof and spoke of what she knew about the Lord, in a city full of fear. A letter about faith in the midst of fear.

versos.texto: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.
She said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

reflexion: The spies were still hidden on the roof. And before they lay down, Rahab went up to speak with them. The first thing she tells them is not a doubt, but a certainty: she knows that the Lord has given them the land. She is from Jericho, from the people who lived in that land. And even so, she recognizes the hand of God.

She also tells what people in the city were living through: fear had fallen on everyone, and they were melting away. It is a hard passage: it speaks of a people terrified at Israel's arrival. There is no need to soften it. In the verses that follow, Rahab tells what they had heard: the Lord dried up the sea, and Israel destroyed two kings.

In the face of that news, she acknowledges that the Lord is God in heaven and on earth. Maybe today you also feel fear around you: at home, at work, in the news. Faith does not always take away the fear around you. But it gives you firm ground to stand on.

Today you can say honestly what you know of God and keep learning as you read his Word. And if fear has you frozen these days, talk with someone you trust or with a professional. That, too, is part of care.
dedicatoria: This letter is for you, who feel fear all around you. In the middle of it, you can put your trust in God.
oracion: Lord, when fear surrounds us, help us turn to you. Give us the simplicity of Rahab to trust in what we already know of you. In Jesus' name, amen.
